question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

events.description:

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's entrenched dominance over the Chinese Communist Party, military, and state institutions underpins the overwhelming trader consensus against his removal before 2027. Term limits were eliminated in 2018, enabling indefinite rule after his third term confirmation in 2022-2023, while ongoing anti-corruption purges have sidelined senior military and political figures, reinforcing loyalty and eliminating potential rivals ahead of the 2027 Party Congress. Recent diplomacy, including the May 2026 Trump summit on "constructive strategic stability," and August Beidaihe leadership gatherings further signal continuity. Realistic shifts could stem from an abrupt health crisis, death, or sudden elite fracture, though no such indicators have emerged in verifiable reporting.
